$comment: Known limitations by feature, vendor and PIX version (YYMM.DD). vendor 'any' applies everywhere. capabilityState is the state a capability reports when nothing probed it. Sources are PIX release notes, PIX docs, the API headers and observations on this server's hardware (verifiedOn). The vendor observations come from one machine with an RTX 4070 Ti, an Intel Arc B580 and an AMD Radeon iGPU, replaying NVIDIA-captured fixtures.

notes.text: Intel static shader profiling has no ISA-to-HLSL source mapping for pixel shaders; instruction and register data are still complete.
Intel static profiling fails for mesh shader pipelines on 2605.28-2606.18.
AMD static shader profiling reports no source line mappings.
Shader Explorer static profiling has no NVIDIA offline compiler; profile NVIDIA shaders live (pix_gpu_shader_profile) or target Intel/AMD.

Live shader profiling (pix_gpu_shader_profile) needs a GPU driver that implements the PIX shader profiling interface. PIX declined it on the RTX 4070 Ti (0x8ABC0007) and the AMD Radeon iGPU (0x8ABC0006) for captures taken on any of the three GPUs; the tool returns an uncached declined marker, and static profiling (pix_gpu_shader_static_profile) still covers AMD and Intel targets.
notes.source: PIX API headers; observed on this server
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU captures / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: On an Intel Arc B580 (driver 32.0.101.8991) live shader profiling failed with E_FAIL (0x80004005) for draws and dispatches, including captures taken on the B580; the tool returns an uncached failed marker. Profile Intel shaders statically (pix_gpu_shader_static_profile with an Xe2 target).
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU captures / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: Stall type names are vendor-defined; the stall classification is a keyword heuristic and the raw names and descriptions are always returned.

Inline static profiling starts from PIX's default pipeline state, whose root signature is empty: shaders that bind resources declare [RootSignature(...)] in HLSL, and the server then drops the default. Captured shaders use the capture's pipeline state.
PIX passes static profiling defines to the compiler as arguments; the server formats NAME=VALUE pairs as -DNAME=VALUE and drops values with spaces or quotes.
Intel static profiling results carry a placeholder shader hash and ISA documentation link; the server reports both as absent.

Intel's offline compiler plugin writes an ASD_CompilationReport_*.md per compile and one when it unloads; the server keeps them in %TEMP%/pixmcp-compiler-reports (a week of reports) instead of the client's working directory.
System Monitor hardware counters (timing-capture sysmon counters) are NVIDIA and AMD only.
System Monitor hardware counters are collected with captureSysmonCounters on NVIDIA and AMD.
System Monitor hardware counters are collected with captureSysmonCounters on NVIDIA and AMD.
High-frequency counter collection returned E_NOTIMPL (0x80004001) on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD GPUs with PIX 2606.18-preview, from the timing pass and from a standalone replay.
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: Occupancy collection returned E_NOTIMPL (0x80004001) on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD GPUs with PIX 2606.18-preview, from the timing pass and from a standalone replay.
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: Intel occupancy is counted in Xe core thread slots; while collection is not implemented, the per-event XVE Threads Occupancy All counter (preset occupancy) substitutes.

On an Intel Arc B580 (driver 32.0.101.8991) the Intel plugin adds 259 per-event counters in 16 INTEL groups (Vector Engine, Thread Dispatcher, Memory, Device Cache, Sampler, ...) to the 22 D3D counters. Names carry no unit; descriptions do (Percentage of time, Number of). GPU Busy and Command Parser Render Engine Busy read about 100 on every replayed event, so per-stage XVE utilization, occupancy and stall counters carry the signal.
On this server's RTX 4070 Ti PIX 2606.18-preview exposes only the D3D pipeline-statistics, depth-occlusion and stream-output counters (22); vendor hardware counters need the NVIDIA plugin.
On an AMD Radeon integrated GPU (driver 32.0.21018.14) PIX 2606.18-preview exposes only the 22 D3D counters, and GS Invocations counts draws that bind no geometry shader.
PIX collects marker (rollup) rows in separate playback rounds; a marker value is never the sum of its children.
Application Specific Driver State is enabled by default from 2606.18; pass DISABLE_GPU_PLUGINS to isolate vendor plugin effects.
The DebugBreak() experiment (2606.18) is listed on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD adapters; running it is unverified.
Bandwidth needs the GPU vendor plugin: it returned GTI throughput on an Intel Arc B580 and failed (0x80004005) on the RTX 4070 Ti and the Radeon iGPU.
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: Intel rules were calibrated on the perf fixture on an Arc B580: the full-screen Lighting pass (Dr. PIX 1x1 viewport saves 97 %) reads XVE ALU0 PS utilization 58 % and thread occupancy 97 %, the same for captures taken on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD GPUs; the Shadow pass stays under 6 %. One synthetic workload backs the Intel block.
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU captures / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: DirectX Dump Files (.dxdmp_preview) are experimental in PIX Preview; layouts can change between builds.
IPixD3DState has no managed projection in PixApiCsExt.experimental 2606.18; D3D state tables are not readable through the API.
Root constant values may be unavailable per binding (E_INVALIDARG from GetValue on 2606.18); coverage entries report it.
GpuFrame is empty in API-taken timing captures; frames come from VSync custom markers instead.
Heterogeneous CPU cores are recorded as PhysicalCores.EfficiencyClass (2606.18); the CpuSample.Core to Cores 1:1 mapping is assumed.
Remote device connections and CopyCaptureFromRemote are unverified on this server (single machine).
File I/O capture (fileIo, fileIoStacks, preset fileIo) records Win32 file events; whether DirectStorage requests appear has not been verified on this server.
Windows may show a UAC prompt when PIX starts its timing recorder; complete it on the desktop, or configure the PIX service for unattended runs.

Memory events, page faults and stacks for all processes can produce multi-GB captures; bound them with maxFileSizeMb and durationSeconds. Video and CLR data may need extra PIX components or elevation, and a failed start lists the option parts it sent.

Without flags PIX chooses the replay behaviour (flagsSource pixDefault) and the effective flags are not observable; 2606.18 applies application-specific driver state by default. Pass DISABLE_GPU_PLUGINS to isolate vendor plugin effects.

PIX declines (0x8ABC006B, analysis_incompatible) to replay a capture on another vendor's GPU unless IGNORE_INCOMPATIBILITIES is set: observed in all six directions between an RTX 4070 Ti, an Intel Arc B580 and an AMD Radeon iGPU, while captures replay on their own vendor without flags. The replayed numbers then describe the replay GPU (provenance vendorMismatch).
notes.verifiedOn: 2026-09-14 RTX 4070 Ti, Arc B580, Radeon iGPU captures / 2606.18-preview

notes.text: The Intel Arc B580 lists five analysis power states (0 Stable power at 2/3 of maximum GPU frequency, 1 Constrained, 2 Minimum, 3 Maximum, 4 Retail); the RTX 4070 Ti and the Radeon iGPU list none. When adapterName, adapterId, flags or powerStateId is given, the server passes power state 0 unless powerStateId says otherwise.
delimiter capturableRegion captures between ID3D12SharingContract BeginCapturableWork and EndCapturableWork calls; an app that never makes them never completes the capture.

pix_gpu_preview eventRef selection and pix_gpu_subcapture rely on pixtool Global IDs equalling native GPU ids; each capture is checked on first use against the one queue save-event-list lists. They matched on the fixture capture, and save-event-list rejects its documented --queue-name option on this build.
